name: How long does professional window weatherstripping replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does professional window weatherstripping replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of professional window weatherstripping replacement depends on the number of windows, their condition, and the type of weatherstripping being installed. A few windows might be completed within a few hours, while a whole-house project could take a full day or longer. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we provide an estimated timeline during our initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Duration varies based on the number of windows and complexity, ranging from a few hours for a few windows to a day or more for a whole house.
